skill.name: pydicom
skill.description: Provides pydicom guidance and local scripts for reading DICOM metadata, converting pixel data, anonymizing selected tags, handling transfer syntaxes, and processing imaging series.
skill.summary: Work with DICOM metadata, images, transfer syntaxes, and local conversion tools using pydicom.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: All 71 static alerts are false positives from Markdown formatting, documentation links, intended local file output, and DICOM metadata handling. However, the bundled anonymizer only edits selected top-level attributes and may leave PHI in private tags, sequences, or pixel data.

remediation.issue: The anonymizer does not provide comprehensive DICOM de-identification.
remediation.suggestion: Implement a DICOM PS3.15 profile, recurse through sequences, remove private data, remap UIDs consistently, and detect burned-in identifiers.

content.value_statement: DICOM workflows require careful handling of metadata, pixels, compression, and patient identifiers. This skill provides pydicom guidance and local utilities for common imaging tasks.
actual_capabilities: Read, inspect, modify, and save DICOM datasets with pydicom.
Extract pixel arrays and handle windowing, color conversion, and multi-frame images.
Convert DICOM pixel data to PNG, JPEG, TIFF, or BMP with a local script.
Export DICOM metadata as readable text or JSON to the console or a local file.
Replace or remove selected top-level patient attributes in a single DICOM file.
Explain transfer syntaxes, compression handlers, sequences, and imaging series workflows.
limitations: The anonymizer is not a complete DICOM de-identification implementation and may leave protected health information.
The skill does not connect to PACS servers or DICOMweb services.
Compressed pixel data may require optional pylibjpeg, Pillow, or GDCM dependencies.
The helper scripts process individual files; full series workflows require additional code.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect a DICOM file
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [file path] and summarize patient, study, series, image, and transfer syntax fields. Do not modify the file.

prompt_templates.title: Convert an image
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [DICOM file] to [PNG, JPEG, or TIFF]. Apply VOI LUT windowing when available and report the selected frame.

prompt_templates.title: Plan de-identification
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [DICOM file or dataset description] for PHI risks. Propose a PS3.15-based de-identification plan and validation checklist before sharing.

prompt_templates.title: Design a series pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a pydicom pipeline for [series directory]. Sort slices, validate geometry, handle compression, preserve spacing, and report inconsistent metadata.

output_examples.output: Not yet approved for sharing. Validate private tags, nested sequences, UID remapping, and burned-in pixel identifiers with an authorized de-identification process.

best_practices: Work on copies and verify required attributes before reading or modifying them.
Preserve transfer syntax, UIDs, spatial metadata, and pixel representation unless the workflow intentionally changes them.
Validate de-identification with an approved profile and independent review before sharing medical data.
anti_patterns: Do not treat removal of a short patient-tag list as complete de-identification.
Do not discard spacing, orientation, frame, or transfer syntax metadata during conversion.
Do not assume every compressed DICOM file can be decoded without optional handlers.

faq.question: Can this skill read compressed DICOM files?
faq.answer: Yes, when pydicom has a compatible decoder. Some transfer syntaxes require optional pylibjpeg, Pillow, or GDCM packages.

faq.question: Does the image converter preserve diagnostic quality?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. Standard image exports may normalize values or reduce bit depth, so they should not replace validated diagnostic workflows.

faq.question: Is the bundled anonymizer sufficient for sharing patient data?
faq.answer: No. It removes selected top-level fields but does not provide complete PS3.15 de-identification or detect burned-in identifiers.

faq.question: Can it process multi-frame DICOM files?
faq.answer: Yes. The converter can select one frame, and the guidance explains access to full multi-frame pixel arrays.

faq.question: Can it connect to PACS or DICOMweb?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts operate on local files and do not implement network retrieval, storage, or query services.

faq.question: What metadata formats can it export?
faq.answer: The metadata script can print readable text or write text and JSON files to a user-selected local path.
